_comment: Numbers both clients use and only StarCore owns. The desktop copies them by hand (WorkingLocation.PEAK_TO_INPUT_RATIO, KeypointDivisor), so each client's test reads this file: the gui against StarCore's own values (DiskSpaceCheck.peakToInputRatio, Config.recommendedReducedKeypointDivisor, the presets and limits the startup prompt offers), the desktop against its copies. Change a value in StarCore and the gui test fails until this file says the same, and then the desktop test fails until its copy does.
